name: Adaption 1
description: For 30s lowers your AC by 1 and raises MR by 1 for every 2 enemies within 2 tiles, up to 13.  If your necklace element matches your stance element, deal 30% more damage.

name: Centered Form 1
description: For 8s gain composure that shifts depending on your stance; Fire: Deal more damage based on your missing health; Earth: Gain 100% Reflect for the full 8s; Water: Remove 1 negative effect and 500 mana + 10% of maximum mana return; Lightning: Charges away for 4/5/6 blocks depending on stacks.  Cannot be used without a stance.

name: Flame Stance 1
description: Builds stacks every 30s, up to 3 stacks.  Depending on your stacks, Reserve 10%/15%/20% of your maximum health and gain 20%/30%/40% more skill/spell damage, 50/100/150 flat damage, and 10%/15%/20% attack speed.  There is a 2 minute commitment before you can shift to another stance.

name: Lightning Stance 1
description: Builds stacks every 30s, up to 3 stacks.  Depending on your stacks, Every hit your skills/spells land, hit a second time for 10%/12.5%/16.5% of the original damage.  Gain a 15%/25%/35% chance to expose the target making them take an extra 30% more damage from the next skill or spell.  There is a 2 minute commitment before you can shift to another stance.

name: Perfect Balance 1
description: For 30s gain max stacks for whichever stance you're currently in.  Cannot be used without a stance.  Pure Only.

name: Rock Stance 1
description: Builds stacks every 30s, up to 3 stacks.  Depending on your stacks, lowers your AC by 5/10/15, and MR raised by 5/10/15.  For every basic attack landed on you there is a 10%/15%/20% to Beag Suain it for 4s.  There is a 2 minute commitment before you can shift to another stance.

name: Searing Focus 1
description: A meditation that lasts for 8 minutes.  Increases natural health regeneration by 5% of your maximum health, and raises your assail and skill damage by 1.5% for every 20 CON.  Casting again will refresh the cooldown, and it will stack with Hot Chocolate and Ice Cold.

name: Shifting Form 1
description: Breaks your current stance, allowing you to shift to another stance early.  Cannot be used while not in a stance.  Pure Only

name: Tide Stance 1
description: Builds stacks every 30s, up to 3 stacks.  Depending on your stacks, Lowers the cooldown of your skills/spells by 5%/10%/15%, and raises your MR by 10/20/30.  When you are hit, strike back to enemies adjacent to you for 750 + 8 x CON + 0.5% of your maximum health as water damage.  There is a 2 minute commitment before you can shift to another stance.
